MOOG PART NUMBER K6345 AND ARE MARKED WITH DATE CODES OF 1049291 THROUGH 1040006.

summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.    SOME OF THESE VEHICLES WERE BUILT WITH REAR SEAT SHOULDER BELTS THAT COULD TWIST, ALLOWING THE WEBBING TO BE JAMMED IN THE RETRACTOR.  WHEN THE SHOULDER BELT WEBBING BECOMES JAMMED IN THE RETRACTOR, THE SEAT BELT BECOMES UNUSABLE.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: BMW/BRAKE LAMPS (17,700 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.    THE BRAKE LAMPS IN THESE VEHICLES ARE CONTROLLED BY A SWITCH ACTIVATED BY THE MOVEMENT OF THE BRAKE PEDAL.  THIS SWITCH COULD FAIL INTERNALLY, CAUSING IT TO REMAIN EITHER IN THE "BRAKE LAMPS OFF" POSITION OR IN THE "BRAKE LAMPS ON" POSITION.

title: Dutchmen Manufacturing, Inc.: DUTCHMEN/FRAME (105 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  TRAVEL TRAILERS.   WOODEN BOARDS WERE MOUNTED BETWEEN THE AXLE BRACKETS AND THE FRAME OF THESE TRAVEL TRAILERS.  THE BOARDS COULD DETERIORATE AND/OR COMPRESS SUFFICIENTLY TO ALLOW THE METAL BRACKET OF THE AXLE MOUNT TO PRESS DOWNWARD AGAINST THE BRACKET SIDE MOUNTING BOLTS.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/AIR BAG MODULE (39 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.  THESE VEHICLES MAY HAVE BEEN BUILT WITH LOWER THAN THE INTENDED LEVEL OF TORQUE ON THE BOLTS THAT ATTACH THE AIR BAG ELECTRONIC CRASH SENSOR MODULE TO THE VEHICLE.

title: RUDCO PRODUCTS, INC.: RUDCO/CONTAINER DOORS (1,604 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  ROLL-OFF CONTAINER DOORS FOR CONSTRUCTION TRAILERS. IMPROPERLY TEMPERED STEEL FLAT BARS WERE INSTALLED.  THE STEEL USED FOR THE HINGE OF THE CONTAINER DOORS WHEN WELDED, BECOMES BRITTLE.  THIS CREATES A RISK THAT THE STEEL MAY CRACK, CAUSING THE ENTIRE DOOR TO FALL OFF UNEXPECTEDLY.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: BLUE BIRD/BRAKE LINES (3,113 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  SCHOOL AND TRANSIT BUSES EQUIPPED WITH BENDIX ABS ANTI-LOCK BRAKING SYSTEM.   THE PRIMARY AND SECONDARY BRAKE TREADLE VALVE AIR LINES WERE INSTALLED INCORRECTLY AT THE BENDIX R12DC RELAY VALVE.

title: Foretravel, Inc.: FORETRAVEL/WINDSHIELD WIPER BLADES (326 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  CLASS A MOTOR HOMES.    DURING ICY CONDITIONS, THE WINDSHIELD WIPER BLADES COULD STICK TO THE WINDSHIELD WHEN THE SYSTEM IS TURNED ON CAUSING THE MOTOR SHAFT TO SPIN ON THE DRIVE ARM IF THE PIVOT NUT IS NOT PROPERLY TORQUED.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: VOLVO TRUCKS/HALDEX/FMVSS 121 (13,516 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  HEAVY DUTY TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH HALDEX MANIFOLD DASH VALVES (MDV) USED IN TRACTOR AND TRAILER PARKING BRAKES.   THESE VALVES DO NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 121, "AIR BRAKE SYSTEMS."  A LOSS OF THE ISOLATION OF THE TWO BRAKE SYSTEM CIRCUITS CAN RESULT IN THE LOSS OF SERVICE BRAKES WHEN THERE IS ANOTHER FAILURE OF ONE OF THE TWO BRAKE CIRCUITS.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: WINNEBAGO/GENERATOR CIRCUIT BREAKER (235 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MOTOR HOMES.   THESE MOTOR HOMES MAY CONTAIN A GENERATOR WITH AN IMPROPERLY SIZED BREAKER FOR ITS INTENDED APPLICATION. A 30-AMP CIRCUIT BREAKER IS INSTALLED WHERE A 20-AMP CIRCUIT BREAKER SHOULD BE.  THIS BREAKER PROTECTS THE CIRCUIT THAT GOES TO A CENTRAL AIR CONDITIONING UNIT.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/BI-FUEL CNG COOLANT LINES (391 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH  BI-FUEL COMPRESSED NATURAL GAS (CNG) VEHICLES.  THE CNG FUEL LINE AND THE CNG HIGH PRESSURE REGULATOR COOLANT LINES CAN CONTACT OTHER FUEL (GASOLINE) AND BRAKE LINES ON THE VEHICLE.  ABRASION FROM CONTACT CAN CAUSE A LEAK IN THE BRAKE PIPE, FUEL PIPE, OR BOTH.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/STEERING CONTROL (1,462 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  CHASSIS CABS.  THE TAPERED HOLE IN THE DRAG LINK END THAT ATTACHES TO THE PITMAN ARM TAPERED BALL STUD MAY BE MACHINED TOO DEEP CAUSING THE HOLE TO BE OVERSIZED.  A DRAG LINK WITH AN OVERSIZED HOLE MAY NOT "SEAT" THE PITMAN ARM TAPERED BALL WHEN ASSEMBLED.  THIS COULD CAUSE HIGHER THAN NORMAL FRICTION BETWEEN COMPONENTS DURING OPERATION, AND POSSIBLY RESULT IN JOINT SEPARATION OR A BROKEN BALL STUD.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/ABS SPRING CLIP (10,674 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:   LIGHT DUTY PICKUP TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH 4-WHEEL DISC BRAKES.  SOME OF THESE VEHICLES HAVE AN ANTILOCK BRAKE SYSTEM (ABS) MOTOR CONTAINING AN OUT-OF-SPECIFICATION SPRING CLIP.  THIS CLIP COULD ALLOW THE MOTOR BEARING TO BECOME MISALIGNED.  IF MISALIGNMENT OCCURS, EVENTUALLY THE ABS WOULD BE NON-FUNCTIONAL.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/BRAKE HOSE/WHEEL (1,000 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  LIMOUSINE AND HEARSE MODEL VEHICLES.  THE RIGHT FRONT BRAKE HOSE CAN CONTACT THE WHEEL RESULTING IN DAMAGE TO THE BRAKE HOSE.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/REAR SHOULDER BELTS (85,253 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:   PASSENGER VEHICLES.  THE REAR SHOULDER BELT(S) DO NOT RETRACT.  A RETAINER COULD SEPARATE FROM A REAR SEAT SHOULDER BELT RETRACTOR WHICH RESULTS IN THE RETRACTOR RETURN SPRING BECOMING DISENGAGED.

title: CPSC, Distributors Announce Recall of "FIRE CAP" Fire and Smoke Suppressants
summary: The product does not suppress fires and could intensify fires. Units: More than 136,000.

title: Pull Toys Recalled by Manhattan Group LLC
summary: The wooden wheels and pegs attached to the toy could come off, presenting a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 3,400.

title: Race Car Collectibles Recalled by Action Performance Companies
summary: The fluorescent light base of the unit becomes extremely hot and can melt, presenting a fire hazard. Units: About 1,600.

title: CPSC, Prometheus International Inc. Announce Recall of Novelty Lighters
summary: The lighters do not have any child-resistant mechanisms, as required by the Consumer Product Safety Act. Young children could ignite the lighters, presenting a fire hazard. Units: About 4,000.

title: Toy Chests Recalled by Thornwood Furniture
summary: The lids on these toy chests could fall onto a child's head or neck. An investigator for the Georgia Office of Consumer Affairs discovered the problem with the toy chest while conducting retail surveillance for CPSC. Units: About 400.

title: CPSC, Shopko Stores Inc. Announce Recall of Baby Garments
summary: The rose-shaped buttons on these garments can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: Approximately 9,800.

title: Ladies' Robes Recalled by HANRO USA
summary: The robes fail to meet federal flammability standards for clothing and can ignite readily, presenting a serious risk of burn injuries. Fabrics that do not comply with the standard typically burn faster than newspaper. Units: About 2,100.

title: Men's Sweatshirts Recalled by Eddie Bauer
summary: The sweatshirts, which fail to meet federal mandatory standards for fabric flammability, could ignite readily and present a serious risk of burn injuries, in violation of the Federal Flammable Fabrics Act. Fabrics that do not comply with the standard typically burn faster than newspaper. Units: Abou

title: Vanguard Engines and Fuel Filters Recalled by Briggs & Stratton
summary: The fuel filters on these engines can leak gasoline, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,600.

title: CPSC, Cadet Recall In-Wall Heaters; Settle Lawsuit
summary: Flames, sparks or molten particles can spew through the front grill cover of the heater into the living area of a residence, putting consumers at risk from fires, including burn injuries, smoke inhalation and property damage. The heaters also can become energized creating a risk of electric shock. U

title: CPSC, Mountain High Hosiery Ltd. Announce Recall of Tommy Hilfiger Socks for Infants and Children
summary: The heat-sealed Tommy Hilfiger flag logo appliques on these socks can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: Approximately 360,000.

title: CPSC, TSI Prime Inc. Announce Recall of Ceiling Light Fixtures
summary: The light fixtures can short circuit, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 126,000.

title: CPSC, Nordstrom Inc. Announce Recall of Infant and Toddler Jackets
summary: Snaps located on the flap pockets of these jackets could be removed, presenting a choking hazard to infants and young children. Units: Approximately 2,250.

title: CPSC, New Cole Sewell Corp. Announce Recall of Storm Doors
summary: These storm doors were manufactured without retaining pins in the upper windows. The upper window can fall out and could injure nearby consumers. Units: About 23,000.

title: CPSC, Dynacraft Industries Inc. Announce Recall of Mountain Bikes
summary: The front suspension forks on these bikes might not have been welded properly, and can break apart during use, resulting in serious injury to the rider. Units: About 19,000.

title: CPSC, Frieder Inc. Announce Recall of Power Strips
summary: The wiring in these power strips is undersized and poses shock, electrocution and fire hazards. Units: About 35,000.
